assertion.statement: Crossplane v2 compositions can compose any resource (MRs, Deployments, third-party CRs), but Crossplane must be granted access to compose non-Crossplane resources.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Text does not state which configurations are exposed; depends on which non-Crossplane resources an environment composes and its RBAC grants.; consequence: Text says access must be granted for non-Crossplane resources but does not state what fails if it is not.
